item.title: This Week In Members Only
item.author: A. Analyst
item.description: The weekly roundup is the one public post that carries real text, which is exactly why the median matters more than the maximum. This week covered the shift in inference pricing, why the analyst consensus on agent frameworks moved twice in a month, and what the latest round of enterprise pilots says about where budget is actually going. The through-line: the interesting constraint has moved from model capability to organisational absorption, and the companies furthest along are the ones that treated the rollout as a process-design problem rather than a procurement one. Subscribers get the full version daily; this roundup is deliberately a sample of it.
